name: subnotes
description: Read the Subnotes notebooks you connect and add tasks to them — so "put that on the backlog" lands in your notebook, not the transcript. Needs the Subnotes app, macOS only.

folder.title: Subnotes Connector folder
folder.description: Optional. Leave blank unless Subnotes stores its data somewhere unusual — the plugin finds the folder Subnotes exports to (~/Subnotes, or the one you picked in Subnotes).
